name: nu_app
description: nu_digitalの公式サイト・内部ポータル・Go API・Discord Botのモノレポ。依存は各アプリ(apps/*)のlockfileで管理する。

scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && npm run web:lint && npm run web:typecheck && npm run admin:lint && npm run admin:typecheck
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/harness.test.mjs && npm run test:editor --prefix apps/web && node --test apps/web/scripts/content-presentation.test.mjs && node --test apps/web/lib/markdown-sanitize.test.mjs && node --test scripts/page-fingerprint.test.mjs && node --test scripts/admin-mock-contract.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run web:build && npm run admin:build
